title: Bound Waves
statement: Implement `solve(n, k)`. `n` jobs run with at most `k` in flight. Return how many waves that takes, which is the ceiling of n/k. `k` less than 1 or `n` less than 0 returns `error`. Zero jobs returns 0.
hints: Reject a bad k or a negative n.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A semaphore of k permits lets k tasks run.

editorial: A semaphore of k permits lets k tasks run. The rest wait. The number of sequential waves, if you batched them, is the ceiling of n/k. That is the latency shape: k-wide, and a short tail still costs a wave.
